*Partnership offers a seamless day of travel from home to gate with CLEAR-approved menu items, Member perks, and a free month of CLEAR+*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- CLEAR® (NYSE: YOU), the secure identity company, today announced a partnership with goop kitchen, the delivery-first restaurant concept founded by Gwyneth Paltrow, known for its delicious, thoughtfully crafted, feel-good food. Designed to take the stress out of travel day dining, the partnership highlights three goop kitchen favorites that are easy to enjoy on the go, all under one simple idea: "No Mess, No Stress."


"We're committed to helping Members enjoy a seamless travel day, every step of the way," said Jane Stanton, SVP, Brand & Marketing, CLEAR. "goop kitchen takes care of a great meal on a busy travel day and CLEAR takes care of the rest. Together, we're powering an even easier, more delightful experience from home to gate and back again."


The three CLEAR-approved menu items are the Summer Salad Roll, the Curry Chicken Salad Summer Roll and the Salmon Teriyaki Hand Roll. Each one is wrapped in clear rice paper and needs no utensils, so travelers can eat on the way to the airport, at the gate, or at home without the mess.


Starting today, CLEAR+ Members can take $10 off their next goop kitchen order, and goop kitchen customers can participate in a one month free trial of CLEAR+, unlocking access to CLEAR+ Lanes at airports nationwide so they can speed through security in seconds. The partnership is the latest example of CLEAR helping Members win the day of travel by identifying and offering solutions for pain points along the way.


"We're so excited to take good, clean food to new heights," said Jena Wolfe, VP of Marketing at goop kitchen. "We've noticed that our customers love picking up goop kitchen before a travel day, and our rolls in particular have become an exceptional in-flight companion, so partnering with CLEAR felt like a natural fit. We're both thinking about how to make the travel experience a little better, whether that means less time in line or something genuinely delicious to look forward to at 30,000 feet."


goop kitchen customers will see the three menu items listed on its website as CLEAR Selects and once purchased, customers will receive an email with information on redeeming a free trial for a month of CLEAR+. CLEAR+ Members traveling from LAX, SFO, and OAK will also have the opportunity to receive a surprise gift while moving through CLEAR+ Lanes the weekend of November 6th, while supplies last.


The partnership reflects a shared belief that a great travel day should be no mess and no stress, from Home to Gate and back again.


**About CLEAR**


The mission of CLEAR, the secure identity company, is to strengthen security and create frictionless experiences. With over 46 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether you are traveling, at the stadium, or on your phone, CLEAR connects you to the things that make you, you—making everyday experiences easier, more secure, and friction-free. CLEAR is committed to privacy done right. Members are always in control of their own information, and we do not sell biometric or sensitive personal data. For more information, visit clearme.com.


**About goop kitchen**


Crafted to make you feel good, goop kitchen serves clean, made-to-order food, without refined sugars, seed oils, or processed additives. Founded by Gwyneth Paltrow, and led by Michelin-trained Chef Kim Floresca, the menu is built around thoughtfully sourced, nutrient-dense ingredients and designed primarily for delivery and takeout.
